_comment: B1-EXT part 3 (Composition PR 4, ACTIVATION_PRECONDITIONS.md) — the DERIVED-WRITE census: every writer that persists composition-DERIVED state (state computed FROM the composed identity/descriptor, not primary user input) must either (a) commit-validate the descriptor transactionally or (b) carry the full source tuple with reader-side rejection. compositionDerivedWrites.census.test.js proves each row's mechanism token is live in the source AND that every censused composition writer class is classified here (derived or excluded) — a new writer doing neither fails CI.

derivedWriters.mechanism: (a)+(b): in-tx epoch+descriptor validation AND projectionGeneration stamp with reader rejection
derivedWriters.readerRejection: assertProjectionCurrent at battle creation (agentBattleService.js); compositionGenerationFence.test.js both directions

derivedWriters.mechanism: (a)+(b): pin-before-resolve + commit-time descriptor re-validation AND manifest/slice generation-stamp pair with assembler-side rejection
derivedWriters.readerRejection: compositionAdvisoryRender admissibility gate rejects mismatched/half stamps

derivedWriters.mechanism: (b): full sourceRevisionVector (identityHash, projectedRulesHash, settingsRev, bundle hashes) with reader-side rejection/recompile in deployBuildValidation.diffSourceRevisionVector; epoch-fenced in the same tx by every censused endpoint caller
derivedWriters.note: the activationGeneration join for compiled builds rides the runbook's candidate-scoped pipeline step (the record does not exist before it); the vector's identityHash component moves on any identity flip, which is the stale-rejection axis of record (A12)

derivedWriters.writer: born-with seed rule docs (change-archetype tx + training-clone provisioning)
derivedWriters.mechanism: (a): the seed derives from the record-selected identity version (resolveSeedSource; unresolvable version FAILS CLOSED); callers pin the descriptor (change-archetype, trainingClone) and the change-archetype tx validates the epoch
derivedWriters.readerRejection: seeded docs project through projectActiveRules into builds whose vector rejects staleness

derivedWriters.mechanism: (a)-analog: the seed source resolves through a record READ (fetchActiveIdentityVersion — every failure path resolves LIVE, fail-safe A24); the record is the only selector (A48)
derivedWriters.readerRejection: same downstream vector axis as archetypeSeeding

excluded.reason: copyAgentSubcollections COPIES primary identity docs (not derived output); fenced by the B2 provisioner lease; its SEED path is censused via archetypeSeeding.js above
clone doc + subcollection copies are primary-state copies under the B2 lease; no composition-derived output
persists USER INPUT (settings), not composition-derived state; epoch-fenced in-tx
feed entries are written into the candidate namespace by the migration apply (epoch-fenced, founder-gated CLI); projection is read-only and A44-gated
post-commit hygiene over already-inert docs; epoch-guarded at entry; deletes nothing derived
writes ONLY the candidate namespace (Method B), epoch-checked, founder-gated --apply --yes; the activation transaction (M6) verifies its output before ratifying

the deploy gate RE-DERIVES a compiled build through writeCompiledBuildsInTx (censused above, revision 'current') — its own writes are that path; its READ side is the (b)-mechanism reader (diffSourceRevisionVector)
admin CLI over MASTERY state (not composition-derived); epoch-guarded per batch (assertWriteEpochOpen, A46 adminCliScripts row); paused out-of-band during the §8 window
admin CLI mutating rule docs (primary state) under the LEGACY map's cleanup semantics; epoch-guarded per batch; paused out-of-band during the window and superseded by the migration at the flip
observe-only walker (append-only observation output, non-authority); epoch-guarded; paused out-of-band during the window
